author: Bogus034
quote: This game will give you a headache. There’s just way too much going on in multiplayer: constant jumping, sliding, UAVs, invisibility camo, EMPs, and every other gimmick imaginable. Half the time it feels more like chaos than a **** who approved some of these weapon skins? They look ridiculous.This is the first Call of Duty I’ve ever bought, played for a few hours, and then deleted from my console. What a disappointment. At this point, they should be offering refund
